amendment_reason: The first infrastructure-only capture attempt produced zero data rows and no payload/evidence/exposure because the U.S. GitHub-hosted runner received HTTP 451 from api.binance.com. Before any 0053 data exposure, the public market-data base is changed prospectively to Binance's official data-api.binance.vision endpoint while preserving the exact /api/v3/klines path, symbols, interval, parameters, pagination, window, fields, canonical hashing and integrity rules.
pagination: For each symbol, request ascending klines from startTime. After each nonempty page advance next startTime to last returned openTime + 14400000 ms. Stop when next startTime >= requested_end_exclusive. Do not use current-time defaults.
canonical_market_payload: Canonical UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true and separators=(',',':') over object {interval,start_ms,end_exclusive_ms,symbols:{BTCUSDT:[raw arrays],ETHUSDT:[raw arrays],SOLUSDT:[raw arrays]}}. SHA256 is computed over these exact bytes. Retrieval timestamp and HTTP metadata are stored outside the hashed market payload.
integrity_rules: Each symbol is strictly ascending by open_time with no duplicates.
Consecutive retained bars for each symbol differ by exactly 14400000 ms; any internal missing bar is DATA_INTEGRITY_INCONCLUSIVE and no fill is allowed.
All retained open_time values are aligned to UTC multiples of four hours.
OHLC values are finite and strictly positive; volume and quote_asset_volume are finite and nonnegative; number_of_trades is nonnegative.
No bar with open_time >= 2026-08-03T00:00:00Z is retained.
The common analysis index is the exact intersection of the three contiguous symbol indices, starting at the maximum first available open_time and ending at the minimum last available open_time.
No cross-venue substitution, synthetic backfill, interpolation or forward fill is allowed.
capture_semantics: Network/API retries are permitted only until one complete internally valid payload has been durably persisted; incomplete zero-row infrastructure failures are not scientific datasets.
Once the first complete valid payload is durably persisted and its SHA256 exposed, no second historical capture may replace it under 0053.
The successful capture becomes researcher-exposed DEVELOPMENT history and is not independent OOS.
Capture may report raw per-symbol bar counts, first/last timestamps, common start/end and integrity status, but it may not calculate Track A/B/C support funnels or any predictive label/metric.
No further base-endpoint change is permitted after the first complete valid payload is exposed.
post_capture_required_artifacts: MARKET_4H_EVIDENCE.json containing retrieval timestamp, market_payload_sha256, per-symbol raw counts, first/last timestamps, common coverage and integrity results
DATASET_DECLARATION.json registering the immutable successful slice
atomic update to config/dataset_exposure_registry.json and the 0053 development_dataset_refs before support-funnel implementation
forbidden: No support-funnel or predictive computation during capture
